intro: This errand carries Apothecary Lydon's freshly mashed Mudsnout Composite from Tarren Mill straight to the heart of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity. Master Apothecary Faranell requires the plant mash to treat it with a colloid of decay, furthering the Forsaken's development of a new plague.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Just when I thought another day was going to pass devoid of any joy, you brought me those marvelous Mudsnout Blossoms.
First I will mix them down into a fine composite. We'll then need Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity to apply his colloid of decay to it and then we'll be ready for some good fun indeed!
Here, take this Mudsnout Composite and run it off to Master Faranell at once, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Can you not see I am busy, adventurer? The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us. And with the human threat pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity. This better be important!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Apothecary Lydon sent you? Ah, why didn't you say so!
Despite his gloomy disposition, Apothecary Lydon is one of our most dedicated and skilled members.

The good chap sends Mudsnout Composite! I know what our friend in Hillsbrad is up to now. And I like the way he thinks. The Dark Lady would be most impressed with the progress he is making toward the new plague.
